80047.subject: Robinhood Agents is live, and it earns from your trades, not the AI 🤖📈; Meta’s Muse now goes head to head with C…
80047.body:
View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/fintechpulse1133

Hey Everyone,
Good morning & happy Thursday! Today, we’re diving into Robinhood Agents, the AI trading agent Robinhood just launched at HOOD Summit with 150,000+ agentic accounts already open (why Robinhood resells the AI at cost and makes its money on your trades instead, how a data marketplace that only works with Robinhood's own agents pulls customers off Claude and ChatGPT, who's on the hook when an agent loses money, & what’s next + bonus deep dive into Robinhood’s latest financials [ https://substack.com/redirect/d9924f0a-fc20-4c51-96e6-ab707c598293?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], How to Build an AI Agent from Scratch [ https://substack.com/redirect/7613f781-c030-480f-b26f-dca7b5b7d484?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], and How to Turn Claude Into a Financial Analyst That Never Sleeps [ https://substack.com/redirect/a7ad4c54-d508-4d5b-a60d-a741f9a2427b?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside), and breaking down Meta's Muse for Small Business going head to head with Anthropic's Claude for Small Business [ https://substack.com/redirect/ee6108b5-cc15-4c1e-a82c-1bccb8774da3?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] (how Muse hit about 5M U.S. downloads in 3 weeks before Meta pointed it at the roughly 200M businesses already on its apps, and why Meta's agent starts with the brand and ad context Claude asks owners to write down themselves, & what’s next + bonus deep dive into The Complete Guide on Using Claude Opus 5.5 [ https://substack.com/redirect/0b8803b5-2274-4209-a032-d86a455ff17f?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], and The Agentic Transition Playbook [ https://substack.com/redirect/029bd261-be0e-46c2-8009-c99d341792b7?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside ). So let’s just jump straight into the finnovative stuff 🌶️
Robinhood Agents is live, and it earns from your trades, not the AI 🤖📈
The news 🗞️ Robinhood Agents, the in-app AI trading agent launched at HOOD Summit this week, isn’t built to earn money from AI. The company resells OpenAI and Anthropic tokens at the models’ public price, and OpenAI is paying for GPT-6 Luna usage through year-end. More than 150,000 agentic accounts are now open, and the pricing shows exactly where Robinhood $HOOD  expects to make money from them and who carries the losses.
Let’s take a closer look at this and unpack the revenue line agents will move, the marketplace rule that pulls customers off their own Claude & ChatGPT, the liability gap House Democrats are now questioning, and why incumbents funded by idle customer cash are most exposed now...

Unsubscribe https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9saW5hcy5zdWJzdGFjay5jb20vYWN0aW9uL2Rpc2FibGVfZW1haWw_dG9rZW49ZXlKMWMyVnlYMmxrSWpveE1Ea3dOVFV6TURnc0luQnZjM1JmYVdRaU9qSXh

80046.subject: 👑 Gemini 4 is out and dethrones ChatGPT
80046.body:
----------
######           [Subscribe](https://academynews.genai.works/)   -    [Collaborate with us](https://utm.genai.works/r/cq9vsh4)


--------------------
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8776fa6e-e2d0-4aec-9648-1bed6de3a659/GenAI_Daily_Banner.jpg?t=1778687445)
Caption: 


----------

----------
**Welcome back!** Google finally dropped Gemini 4, and it's level with ChatGPT's best model. Sam Altman skipped a Senate hearing on rogue AI, and hours later the FTC confirmed it's investigating OpenAI and Anthropic. GPT-6 Astra read a Napoleonic war letter nobody could crack for 217 years. And a new book shows how much Anthropic's founders can't stand OpenAI, with a cameo from a lazy stuffed cat.

**In today's Generative AI Newsletter:**

* **Google:** Is Gemini 4 as good as the benchmarks say?

* **OpenAI:** Why did Altman say no to the Senate?

* **GPT-6 Astra:** What did Napoleon want his general to know?

* **Anthropic:** Which stuffed animal told executives to cancel meetings?


----------







----------
## Google's Gemini 4 caught up with ChatGPT

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/45080403-7e67-46cc-90f0-b8014ce4a061/Oct_1_-_1.jpg?t=1790843328)
Caption: 

Google [announced Gemini 4 Argon](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/gemini-models/gemini-4-argon/), its first new flagship model in almost a year. On Google's own chart, it beats GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 on 12 of 18 tests.

Artificial Analysis, the independent benchmark site, gave it 53. That ties GPT-6 Astra. Opus 5.5 still holds the top score at 58.

* It can write up to 1 million tokens in one answer, up from 64,000

* It launches at $2 in and $10 out per million tokens, a fifth of Astra's price, then doubles after the intro period

* It made things up 15% of the time on one test, compared with 51% for Astra

* It still trails Astra and Opus on some coding tests

You can't use it yet. It's going to the US government and a small group of cyber defenders first. Paid API customers and Google AI Ultra subscribers are next, with no date.

Not everyone at Google is sold. Bloomberg reports some employees think it looks better on benchmarks than in real coding work, especially when it's building how apps and websites look. This is what we call benchmaxxing. Google says that's inaccurate.

Bettors on Polymarket now give Google an 83% chance of having the top model by the end of October. We'll see if it holds up once real users get it.


----------
